purpose: Local source-router registry for proposal-only source recommendations during skill-sync runs.

defaults.source_reference_default: reference-first; do not clone during proposal-only source recommendations
defaults.clone_allowed_when: only after the user task requires source inspection or implementation, and authority, license, target ROS distro, package branch/release, hardware model, and maintenance status are verified
defaults.ros2_recommendation_default: for modern ROS2 robotics tasks, prefer ROS2 sources or the ROS2 subpath of mixed sources; never substitute ROS1 legacy sources for ROS2 unless explicitly framed as historical/protocol reference
defaults.community_repo_default: community_repos are discovery/reference only; do not recommend cloning as an implementation baseline unless no official source exists and the user accepts local validation
defaults.rolling_docs_policy: ROS Rolling docs are development references; use the target released distro docs for operational instructions

bundles.title: Robotics force/torque sensor sources
bundles.recommended_when: The session discusses force/torque sensors, WrenchStamped data, robot contact force measurement, ATI Net F/T, Bota, SCHUNK, Robotiq, or ROS2 force/torque broadcasting.

sources.title: ros2_control Force Torque Sensor Broadcaster
sources.trust_rule: Use as the first ROS 2 interface baseline for publishing force/torque state interfaces as WrenchStamped; verify target ROS distro and controller version before operational guidance. Rolling docs are development references.
sources.notes: Includes sensor_filter_chain support in current rolling docs.

sources.title: ATI Net F/T ROS driver
sources.role: ATI Net F/T legacy driver baseline
sources.trust_rule: Treat ros-drivers as a major ROS organization source, not ATI official. For ROS2 work, use this only as framework/protocol reference; do not clone or pull it as an implementation baseline.
sources.notes: Useful historical reference for ATI NET/FT RDT over Ethernet; repository is ROS1/catkin-era and not a current ROS2 baseline.

sources.title: Bota FT Stack
sources.trust_rule: Use Bota docs and Botasys GitLab as official. Prefer the ROS2 examples for current ROS2 work; verify generation, communication interface, and ROS2 package version before local hardware instructions.
sources.notes: Bota docs cover C++, Python, and ROS2 driver paths.

sources.title: SCHUNK force torque sensor ROS2 driver
sources.trust_rule: Treat SCHUNK-SE-Co-KG GitHub as official; verify sensor model, Ethernet interface box, target distro, and lifecycle behavior before use.
sources.notes: Official ROS2 driver for SCHUNK FTS hardware.

sources.title: Robotiq force torque ROS sources
sources.trust_rule: Treat ROS wiki and ros-industrial/robotiq as historical ROS1 context only; the repo is not active vendor support. Treat ROS2 Robotiq drivers as community discovery sources unless vendor ownership and maintenance are verified.
sources.notes: Good for discovery and legacy behavior, not a default modern ROS2 recommendation without local validation.

bundles.notes: Mixed ROS1/ROS2 bundle. Prefer official ROS2/vendor sources for current ROS2 work; keep ATI/Robotiq ROS1 legacy sources as framework/protocol reference only. Clone default is no-clone; future pullable candidates must be ROS2 and still require distro, hardware, license, and maintenance checks.

bundles.title: Robotics sensor noise filtering sources
bundles.recommended_when: The session discusses filtering noisy sensor data, WrenchStamped smoothing, low-pass filters, Butterworth filters, ROS filter chains, or force/torque signal processing.

sources.title: ROS filters
sources.trust_rule: Use as the standard ROS2 filter-chain API baseline; verify ROS distro support and plugin availability before implementation guidance.
sources.notes: ROS Index currently tracks AMENT_CMAKE/ROS2 package releases.

sources.title: ros2_control filter-chain integration
sources.trust_rule: Use for ROS2 controller-level filtering proposals; verify target controller version and filter plugin configuration before code changes. Rolling docs are development references.
sources.notes: ForceTorqueSensorBroadcaster supports sensor_filter_chain; Chained Filter Controller wraps filter_chain for controller interfaces.

sources.title: SciPy signal processing
sources.role: offline analysis and filter design reference
sources.trust_rule: Use for offline filter design, log analysis, and parameter exploration; do not treat SciPy examples as real-time robot control guidance without latency and stability validation.
sources.notes: Useful for Butterworth/IIR/FIR analysis before translating parameters into ROS runtime filters.

bundles.notes: Mixed ROS2/non-ROS bundle. Use ROS2 filters/ros2_control for deployed ROS2 runtime paths; use SciPy only for offline filter design and log analysis. Clone default is no-clone unless code-level inspection is required and target distro/package version is verified.
